summary: A reconcile pass no longer revokes a start that finished while the pass was running, so the seat or task that start launched keeps running instead of being stopped right after its launch.

replay.detail: No claim, replay or projection change.

schema.detail: No storage or schema change; the pass rereads the existing local start record under the start lock it already takes.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change. A start whose launch worker really ended without a result is still revoked as before.

downtime.detail: No service interruption; one extra read of the local pending starts when a pass finds a start with no running worker.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to restore the earlier behavior.
